researchSummary.whatGameIs: WARDOGS is a tactical large-scale FPS by BULKHEAD, published by Team17, released into Steam Early Access on 2026-09-10.
researchSummary.coreMatch: Up to 100 players are split across Valkyra, Lonestar and Manticore to contest a Control Zone; Team17 describes a randomized 2x2 km Control Zone inside a 256 km² battlefield, with the first team to 100 points winning.
researchSummary.economy: Players start with $10,000; cash persists between matches; each life involves purchasing a loadout, and teamplay actions can generate cash.
researchSummary.currentDataAnchor: Season 1 / Patch 0.11, based on latest numbered official patch found through 2026-09-19.
researchSummary.officialAvailability: Windows PC via Steam Early Access; Team17 also lists GeForce NOW. Official announcements state consoles are planned for 2028 without a specific store URL in the researched official material.
